vo.en: Stop blinking. AI is watching you.

visual.description: Macro shot of a man's eye with the pupil contracting sharply.

vo.en: Right now, job interviewers and banks use stealth software to scan your internal honesty score.

visual.description: A man in a suit looking at a glowing laptop screen in a dark office.

vo.en: When you feel stress, your pupils widen. It’s an involuntary biometric leak that no human can hide.

visual.description: Digital biometric patterns and data points mapped over a man's face.

vo.en: But here’s the creepy part. This technology is being used right now in secret.

visual.description: A fast-moving abstract digital glitch with flashing blue and cyan light.

vo.en: Advanced algorithms track every micro-shift in your gaze to decide if you’re a high-risk person.

visual.description: High-speed scrolling green code and data visualizations on a dark monitor.

vo.en: It’s called Eye-tracking Analysis, and it determines your future before you even finish speaking.

visual.description: Close up of a man's hand signing a formal document with a fountain pen.

vo.en: Subscribe for more dark tech secrets and comment STILL if you didn't blink. Biometrics are watching, which is exactly why...

visual.description: A modern security camera lens rotating slowly against a city background.
